integrity: The exact statements have a self-contained analytic derivation and accompanying reproducible numerical diagnostics; finite checks are not a proof and no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent angular-uniform four-point sampling on one Euclidean circle only.
The signed Pitot defect is a side-sum measure of incircle feasibility, not an optimal geometric displacement.
No finite-sample error bounds or nonuniform-sampling theorem.

title: A sharp Pitot-defect law and marked near-bicentric shapes of random cyclic quadrilaterals
